rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Feng, the Chinese look-flesh creature, a two-eyed living mass shaped like an ox liver.
ANATOMY: one smooth lobed asymmetrical fleshy mass with the broad curved outer silhouette of an ox liver, exactly TWO large watchful eyes embedded directly in the mass; no head, no mouth, no nose, no limbs, no teeth, no blood or exposed organ detail. Matte dark walnut-maroon exterior, fully intact skinlike surface, not a butcher's organ. [feng-mythology-c01,c05,c06]
MOMENT: swell and reform toward the camera; one smooth peripheral indentation is closing as the whole mass returns to its former rounded shape, the two eyes rotating to fix directly on the viewer.
POWER: regeneration shown as a smooth seamless lobe bulging back into its previous form, no cut surface or gore; the creature is never consumed and regrows. [feng-mythology-c02,c05]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme macro ground-level close view, the broad flesh-mass and its two unblinking eyes occupy 85 percent of the square; do not imply giant dimensions.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one sliver of low amber evening light across the eyes, deep cool forest shadows, fine natural dust.
SURFACE: soft rubbery matte skinlike texture with shallow wrinkles, intact smooth surface; wet leaf litter and dark stone.
SETTING: dark rocky mountain slope with woodland litter, Mount Di from the classical account. [feng-mythology-c13]
MOOD: deeply uncanny and imposing through impossible living anatomy, never cute, food photograph or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text/logo/border/frame/watermark; exactly two eyes and zero limbs; no human miniature variant, no Jupiter orb; no blood, wounds, dissection, exposed viscera, gore or eating scene; no film/game/anime/comic design; no aura, glow, neon or energy ribbons.
depicted_variant: Shirou dua mata dengan bentuk massa menyerupai hati sapi, permukaan utuh non-gore.

visual_requirements.description: Massa daging berprofil hati sapi dengan tepat dua mata; tidak bertubuh humanoid dan tanpa gore.
Regenerasi bentuk utuh sebagai lobus halus kembali menggembung, tanpa luka terbuka.

aura: Dua mata pada massa tanpa anggota c05 dan pembentukan ulang c02 memberi keganjilan.
artistic_choices: Tidak memadukan varian manusia kecil c10.
Permukaan utuh matte dan pembengkakan non-gore menyampaikan regenerasi c05; warna/pencahayaan editorial.

notes: Uji Sangar 7/7 native+200px: massa lobus bentuk hati-sapi memenuhi bingkai, tepat dua mata frontal jelas dan tanpa kepala/mulut/anggota; bulging lobus mulus ditafsir sebagai pembentukan ulang c02/c05 tanpa gore. Tatapan uncanny bukan hewan biasa, cahaya/latar alami tanpa efek rekaan; tidak ada teks atau desain IP.
